sessions.phase_label: Automation scope definition and project setup
Keyword automation configuration and runtime testing

requirements.title: Automatic Replies to Comments
requirements.definition: Automatically reply to social-media comments on the configured accounts where the platform supports this behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers general comment-triggered replies only; like-triggered replies and configured keyword responses are independently testable behaviors.

requirements.title: Automatic Replies to Likes
requirements.definition: Automatically respond to social-media likes on configured accounts where the platform supports this behavior.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept separate from comment replies because likes are a distinct engagement trigger with potentially different platform support and execution behavior.

requirements.title: Keyword-Triggered Responses
requirements.definition: Detect configured social-engagement keywords and send the response or resource mapped to each keyword.
requirements.boundary_note: The keyword list and corresponding resource mappings are attributes of one trigger-and-response mechanism; complete rendering of a delivered PDF is independently testable and excluded.

requirements.title: Complete PDF Response Content
requirements.definition: PDF content delivered through an automated response must display completely without omitting or truncating words.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated from keyword recognition and resource selection because a keyword can trigger the correct PDF while the PDF content still displays incorrectly.

unresolved_candidates.description: It is unclear whether C2 Financial requires a separately active automation configuration or is intentionally left in draft because it shares the same social pages with the other business.

The opening job description requests direct-message replies, while message 1 requests replies to likes; available evidence does not establish whether direct-message automation is an additional independent Requirement or whether one description supersedes the other.

The opening job description requests lead capture and routing into the appropriate workflow, but no supplied message with a stable message ID independently establishes the expected capture and routing behavior.

The opening job description mentions follow-up after a keyword-triggered response, but the supplied message evidence does not define the follow-up sequence well enough to determine whether it is an independent Requirement.
